title: INFORMACJA DOTYCZĄCA ROZLICZENIA PODATKU
content:
Source list scan draft.

Source: MF podatki.gov.pl - PIT CIT i rozliczenia
URL: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/media/itin0muf/informacja-cit-za-2024-r.pdf

Summary:
- This official document from the Ministry of Finance (Departament Podatków Dochodowych, Warszawa) outlines PIT/CIT settlements for legal persons (CIT) for the year 2024, with content relevant to corporate income tax and to enterprise-level tax settlements.
- It includes sections on: general data, revenues and costs, income, exemptions, deductions from income, reductions from tax base, and tax due, as well as comparative data and contact information.
- The material appears to be a formal guidance or information bulletin (Wstęp and Spis treści) for corporate taxpayers, detailing eligible entities, tax bases, and applicable deductions and exemptions, with references to “Estoniskiego CIT” (likely a placeholder or typographical variant related to corporate tax information).
